      "component": "POST /exports endpoint",
      "likelihood": 5,
      "impact": 5,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "all", "harm": "sensitive_data" },

        "title": "Derive the exported organisation from the session, not the request body",

      "component": "POST /exports endpoint",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "sensitive_data" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Account admins call POST /exports to export all users in their organisation as CSV, including names, email addresses and phone numbers." }
      ],
      "asvs": ["V8.1.1"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-862"],
      "plainLanguage": "The design assumes only admins will call this, but nothing checks the caller is an admin, so any user could pull the whole member list.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Enforce the admin role server-side on every export call",
        "given": "an authenticated non-admin user of an organisation",
        "when": "they call POST /exports for their own organisation",
        "then": "the server rejects the request with 403 and returns no user records"
      }
    },

      "stride": "InformationDisclosure",
      "title": "CSV formulas in user-supplied names execute when the export is opened",

      "impact": 4,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "medium", "reach": "many", "harm": "sensitive_data" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "export all users in their organisation as CSV, including names, email addresses and phone numbers" }

      "asvs": ["V1.5.4"],
      "cwe": ["CWE-1236"],
      "plainLanguage": "A user could put a spreadsheet formula in their name so it runs on the admin's computer when the exported file is opened.",

        "title": "Neutralise formula characters in exported CSV fields",
        "given": "a user record whose name, email or phone field begins with =, +, -, @, tab or carriage return",
        "when": "the organisation export is generated",
        "then": "the field is escaped or prefixed so no spreadsheet application interprets it as a formula, and the original text is preserved"
      }
    },

      "stride": "DenialOfService",
      "title": "Unbounded full-directory export can be called repeatedly to exhaust resources",

      "component": "CSV export generator",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "rating": { "attacker": "user", "effort": "low", "reach": "all", "harm": "availability" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "Account admins call POST /exports to export all users in their organisation as CSV" }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-770"],
      "plainLanguage": "Asking for every user at once, over and over, could slow down or stall the service for everyone.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Bound and throttle bulk exports",
        "given": "an organisation with a large number of users",
        "when": "an admin requests an export, or repeats the request while one is in progress",
        "then": "the export runs as a bounded asynchronous job with a per-organisation concurrency and frequency limit, and extra requests are rejected or coalesced rather than executed"
      }
    },
    {
      "stride": "Repudiation",
      "title": "Bulk PII extraction leaves no attributable record",
      "scenario": "The design describes no record of who exported which organisation and when.       "component": "POST /exports endpoint",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "rating": { "attacker": "insider", "effort": "low", "reach": "many", "harm": "minor" },
      "evidence": [
        { "quote": "The organisation id comes from the request body." }
      ],
      "asvs": [],
      "cwe": ["CWE-778"],
      "plainLanguage": "If someone downloads a whole company's contact list, there is no trace of who did it or which company was taken.",
      "requirement": {
        "title": "Record an attributable event for every export",
        "given": "any successful or rejected call to POST /exports",
        "when": "the request is processed",
        "then": "an immutable event is recorded with the caller identity, requested organisation id, record count and timestamp, retained long enough to support breach investigation"
      }
    }
  ]
